title: Capped output update
statement: For a current cap value $c\in\{\text{none},\text{a Boolean symbol},\text{overflow}\}$ and an optional emitted Boolean $e$, the updated cap is unchanged if nothing is emitted; if a symbol is emitted and the cap was empty, it records that symbol; if a symbol is emitted when the cap was already nonempty, it records overflow.
